description:
Blue Sky Plan 5 is open on the Windows desktop with a real anonymized dental CBCT scan already loaded, showing axial, cross-sectional, panoramic, and 3D views.

Your task:
1. Select the Distance measurement tool from the toolbar (ruler/line icon, or access via the measuring tools menu).
2. Measure the distance from the crest of the alveolar ridge to the inferior alveolar nerve canal in the lower right first molar region.
3. Click to place the first measurement point at the top of the alveolar ridge.
4. Click to place the second measurement point at the superior border of the mandibular canal.
5. The measurement should appear on screen showing the distance in millimeters.
6. Take note of the measured distance value.
7. Save the project with the measurement to C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\BlueSkyPlanTasks\measurement.bsp.

This measurement is clinically important for determining available bone height for implant placement.
